scenarios.actions_hint: What happens on scenario events, for example sending the collected data to your system.
scenarios.activate_confirm: Make version {v} active? New conversations will use it from the next message.
scenarios.activate_on_save: Make this version active right away
scenarios.ask_after_hint: The bot asks this field only when these fields are filled.
scenarios.cancel_hint: Describe in plain words when the client no longer wants this. The bot then closes the scenario.
scenarios.description_hint: What this scenario is for. The bot sees it, so write it for the bot too.
scenarios.disable_confirm: Switch the scenario off? It stops starting in all channels; open runs are not closed.
scenarios.field_description_hint: What counts as a good answer. Helps the bot ask and pick out the value.
scenarios.fields_hint: What the bot asks the client, in this order. The answers go to the result.
scenarios.filters_hint: Yes/no questions about the answer. All must be “yes”, otherwise the bot asks again.
scenarios.json_hint: The same scenario as JSON. Changes here show up in the form.
scenarios.key_hint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and underscores. Cannot be changed later.
scenarios.main_language_hint: If a text is missing in some language, the bot translates it from this one.
scenarios.not_an_object: The text must describe one object (key: value).
scenarios.note_placeholder: A short note for the version list
scenarios.question: Question
scenarios.question_hint: A hint for the bot: it words the question itself each time.
scenarios.resume: If the client comes back after a long break
scenarios.resume_hint: For example, a booking makes sense only for a day, while an interview can go on in a week.
scenarios.start_ask: Yes/no question about the client message
scenarios.start_field_hint: “yes” when the message answers the field {field}
scenarios.start_hint: Signs that the client wants this scenario. Each sign that gets “yes” adds its weight; the scenario starts when the sum reaches the threshold.
scenarios.starts_when: Starts, for example, when these say “yes”:
scenarios.sub: What the bot collects from clients and what it does with the data.
scenarios.text_missing: No text in this language yet: the bot will translate from the main language
scenarios.threshold_over: The threshold {threshold} is above the sum of all weights ({total}), so the scenario would never start.
scenarios.title: Name
scenarios.yaml_hint: The same scenario as YAML. Changes here show up in the form.
